artifact.canonical_name: Turning the TIDE: Cross-Architecture Distillation for Diffusion Large Language Models

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26951v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: We present TIDE, the first framework for cross-architecture dLLM distillation, comprising three modular components: (1) TIDAL, which jointly modulates distillation strength across training progress and diffusion timestep to account for the teacher's noise-dependent reliability; (2) CompDemo, which enriches the teacher's context via complementary mask splitting to improve predictions under heavy masking; and (3) Reverse CALM, a cross-tokenizer objective that inverts chunk-level likelihood matching, yielding bounded gradients and dual-end noise filtering.
claims.context: Paper abstract / author description; technical results remain author-reported.
